args.subject: Q3 update
args.body:
Dear Board Members,

Please find below our Q3 financial performance summary:

Q3 Highlights:
- Revenue grew 15% YoY
- Operating margin improved to 22%
- Customer acquisition costs remained stable
- Retention rate held steady at 94%

We are on track for our full-year targets. Detailed analysis will be discussed in our upcoming board meeting.

Best regards
